trace.question: what is the open quotation value

tasks.sql:
WITH rpt_quotes AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.deal_id, src.deal_title, src.quote_number, src.version, src.status, src.currency_code, src.subtotal, src.discount_pct, src.discount_amount, src.total, src.valid_until, src.sent_at, src.accepted_at, src.created_by_user_id, src.owner_user_id, src.owner_name, src.approval_status, src.created_at, src.updated_at FROM (
SELECT 
  q.id,
  q.organization_id,
  q.deal_id,
  d.title AS deal_title,
  q.number AS quote_number,
  q.version,
  q.status,
  COALESCE(q.currency, 'USD') AS currency_code,
  COALESCE(q.subtotal, 0) AS subtotal,
  COALESCE(q.discount_pct, 0) AS discount_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(q.subtotal, 0) * (COALESCE(q.discount_pct, 0) / 100.0), 2) AS discount_amount,
  COALESCE(q.total, 0) AS total,
  q.valid_until,
  q.sent_at,
  q.accepted_at,
  q.created_by_user_id,
  d.owner_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS owner_name,
  q.approval_status,
  q.created_at,
  q.updated_at
FROM crm.quotes q
LEFT JOIN crm.deals d ON d.id = q.deal_id AND d.organization_id = q.organization_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = d.owner_user_id
WHERE q.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS open_quote_value FROM rpt_quotes AS quotes WHERE status IN ('draft', 'sent') AND TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE LIMIT 500
